package domain

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"time"
)

// Course represents a final learning product.
type Course struct {
	ID               string
	Slug             string
	SourceKey        string
	CreatedAt        time.Time
	UpdatedAt        time.Time
	MainTechID       *int
	Status           int
	CatalogVisible   bool              `json:"catalog_visible"`
	LessonReadAccess *LessonReadAccess `json:"lesson_read_access,omitempty"`
}

// CoursePreview contains localized summary for listing.
type CoursePreview struct {
	ID          string
	Slug        string
	Title       string
	Description string
}

// Course status constants.
const (
	CourseStatusNoActive = 0
	CourseStatusDraft    = 1
	CourseStatusActive   = 2
)

// Module status constants.
const (
	ModuleStatusNoActive = 0
	ModuleStatusActive   = 1
)

// Module visibility constants.
const (
	ModuleVisibilityCourseOnly = 1
	ModuleVisibilityStandalone = 2
	ModuleVisibilityBoth       = 3
	ModuleVisibilityInternal   = 4
)

// Section status constants.
const (
	SectionStatusNoActive = 0
	SectionStatusActive   = 1
)

// LessonVersion status constants.
const (
	LessonVersionStatusNoActive = 0
	LessonVersionStatusActive   = 1
)

// TechVersion represents a concrete version for a technology.
type TechVersion struct {
	ID        int
	TechID    int
	Version   string
	CreatedAt time.Time
}

// Tech represents a reusable technology label.
type Tech struct {
	ID        int
	Label     string
	CreatedAt time.Time
}

// Tag represents a tag for courses/lessons.
type Tag struct {
	ID        int
	Name      string
	Slug      string
	CreatedAt time.Time
}

// ComposeConfig represents a reusable compose configuration.
type ComposeConfig struct {
	ID          string
	Title       *string
	Description *string
	Config      json.RawMessage
	Status      int
	CreatedAt   time.Time
}

// CourseI18n stores localized course title/description.
type CourseI18n struct {
	CourseID    string
	I18nID      int
	Title       string
	Description string
}

// Module represents a reusable course block grouped by technology.
type Module struct {
	ID               string
	SourceKey        string
	TechID           *int
	Status           int
	Visibility       int
	LessonReadAccess *LessonReadAccess `json:"lesson_read_access,omitempty"`
	CreatedAt        time.Time
	UpdatedAt        time.Time
}

// ModuleI18n stores localized module title/description.
type ModuleI18n struct {
	ModuleID    string
	I18nID      int
	Language    string
	Title       string
	Description string
}

// Section represents a reusable module section grouped by technology.
type Section struct {
	ID               string
	SourceKey        string
	TechID           *int
	Status           int
	LessonReadAccess *LessonReadAccess `json:"lesson_read_access,omitempty"`
	CreatedAt        time.Time
	UpdatedAt        time.Time
}

// SectionI18n stores localized section title/description.
type SectionI18n struct {
	SectionID   string
	I18nID      int
	Language    string
	Title       string
	Description string
}

// CourseModule stores course-module order and status.
type CourseModule struct {
	CourseID string
	ModuleID string
	Order    int
	Status   int
}

// ModuleSection stores module-section order and status.
type ModuleSection struct {
	ModuleID  string
	SectionID string
	Order     int
	Status    int
}

// LessonVersion stores the technology version attached to a lesson.
type LessonVersion struct {
	LessonID      string    `json:"lesson_id"`
	TechVersionID int       `json:"tech_version_id"`
	Status        int       `json:"status"`
	CreatedAt     time.Time `json:"created_at"`
}

// I18n represents a language entry.
type I18n struct {
	ID       int
	Language string
}
